run_deformable_cube_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads and drops a reduced deformable cube onto a plane
load_reduced_deformable_urdf: load a reduced deformable cube URDF model into a pybullet physics simulation at a given position
configure_sparse_sdf_voxel: set the sparse SDF voxel size parameter for the pybullet physics engine to control deformable resolution
apply_texture_to_visual_shape: change a pybullet visual shape to apply a loaded texture and set its RGBA color
step_simulation_loop: run a pybullet simulation step loop that captures camera images while connected to the physics client
